# Moves

Part of the **Inventory** API. Base URL `https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1` — replace the host with your own installation and the token placeholder with a real Bearer token (see [Authentication](/master/api-reference/authentication)).

## List moves

<Badge type="tip" text="GET" /> `/admin/api/v1/inventories/moves`

Retrieve a paginated list of move lines with reusable relation filters

> 🔒 Requires a valid Bearer token.


**Query parameters**

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description | Example |
|-----------|------|----------|-------------|---------|
| `include` | string | No | Comma-separated relationships to include | `move,operation,product` |
| `filter[id]` | string | No | Filter by move line IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[move_id]` | string | No | Filter by move IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[operation_id]` | string | No | Filter by operation IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[product_id]` | string | No | Filter by product IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[lot_id]` | string | No | Filter by lot IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[package_id]` | string | No | Filter by package IDs | `1,2` |
| `filter[scrap_id]` | string | No | Filter by scrap IDs (through move) | `1,2` |
| `filter[warehouse_id]` | string | No | Filter by warehouse IDs (through move) | `1,2` |
| `filter[location_id]` | string | No | Filter by source/destination location IDs | `1,2` |
| `sort` | string | No | Sort field | `-created_at` |

```bash [cURL]
curl -X GET "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/moves?include=move%2Coperation%2Cproduct&filter%5Bid%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bmove_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Boperation_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bproduct_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Blot_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bpackage_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bscrap_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bwarehouse_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Blocation_id%5D=1%2C2&sort=-created_at" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}" \
  -H "Accept: application/json" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json"
```

```python [Python]
import requests

url = "https://your-domain.com/admin/api/v1/inventories/moves?include=move%2Coperation%2Cproduct&filter%5Bid%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bmove_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Boperation_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bproduct_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Blot_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bpackage_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bscrap_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Bwarehouse_id%5D=1%2C2&filter%5Blocation_id%5D=1%2C2&sort=-created_at"

headers = {
    "Authorization": "Bearer {YOUR_AUTH_TOKEN}",
    "Accept": "application/json",
    "Content-Type": "application/json",
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)

data = response.json()
print(data)
```
